programs.description: An earthquake cracks open the bottom of a lake, releasing a prehistoric species of piranha. As sinister events unfold due to the flesh-eating fish, a group of strangers teams up to stop the bloodbath.
Jerry, a mischievous mouse, takes refuge in a fancy hotel that is set to host a wedding. In order to get rid of him, one of the event planners hires Jerry's feline rival, Tom.
Dan Barnes, a former professional boxer, takes up the responsibility to coach Matthew Miller, a teenager who is repeatedly bullied by a school boxing champion and his friends.
Gemini said Angel and Rich trade firearms after Angel's release from jail. However, chaos erupts when they storm a lounge and slay a munitions merchant.
Two former black ops operatives are required to transfer two female convicts to a prison. While on their way, unknown assailants attack them.
Ostracized by everyone for being the child of a cruel overlord, a teen assembles his fellow ninjas to fight off his father.
Steppenwolf and his Parademons return after aeons to destroy Earth. However, Batman seeks the help of Wonder Woman to recruit The Flash, Cyborg and Aquaman to fight their new powerful enemy.
Agent Ethan Hunt fights against a rogue terrorist and rushes to prevent a deadly virus from spreading. To avert a global catastrophe, Ethan has to bring everything to an end.
Red, Chuck and Bomb have always been the outcasts within a community of flightless birds on an island. But when mysterious green pigs intrude the island, it is up to them to figure out the reason.

programs.showName: The Mummy: Tomb of the Dragon Emperor
programs.description: Explorer Rick O'Connell and his family face Emperor Han, an ancient Chinese ruler resurrected by a rogue military faction in China via a mystical gemstone.
When his former superior, Colonel Samuel, asks him to join him on a special mission in Afghanistan, Rambo declines. However, when he is held hostage and tortured, Rambo decides to step in.
A desert warrior rises up against the evil army destroying his homeland. After capturing the enemy's key sorcerer, he takes her deep into the desert and prepares for a final showdown.
Peter Parker faces Electro and his old friend who is dying and looks out for Spider-Man's blood in order to cure himself.
An ancient princess is awakened from her crypt beneath the desert, bringing with her malevolence grown over millennia and terrors that defy human comprehension.
Bruce Banner, a genetics researcher with a tragic past, suffers an accident that causes him to transform into a raging green monster when he gets angry.
